name: cascade-qa
description: Plan quality, design tests, assess evidence, and triage defects from accepted behavior without taking product definition, host execution, test repair, or release authority.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, design, assess, and triage product quality.
interface.longDescription: Turn accepted behavior and risks into quality plans and test cases, assess frozen evidence conservatively, and classify defects for the correct implementation or test-repair owner.
defaultPrompt: Create a risk-based quality plan for this accepted behavior.
Design traceable test cases for this requirement.
Assess this evidence or triage these failures.
